1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""
3	Exp-D: Conjecture 1 Extended Verification (Envelope Monotonicity)
4	
5	Part 1: 10,000 random Dirichlet(1,...,1) C0 per (topology, K) -- 210,000 total tests
6	Part 2: Adversarial search via scipy.minimize for K in {3, 5} -- 500 starts per config
7	
8	Conjecture 1:
9	  |B(delta)| non-decreasing for {confounding, mediation, exposure, frontdoor, iv}
10	  |B(delta)| non-increasing for {collider, mbias}
11	
12	where B(delta) = plim(C(delta)) - tau_true, C(delta) = (1-delta)I + delta*C0.
13	"""

62	def make_p_A(K):
63	    if K == 3:
64	        return np.array([0.40, 0.35, 0.25])
65	    raw = np.array([1.0 / i for i in range(1, K + 1)])

91	def _softmax_rows(logits):
92	    e = np.exp(logits - logits.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))
93	    return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
94	
95	
96	def _sample_cat(probs, rng):
97	    cum = np.cumsum(probs, axis=1)
98	    u = rng.uniform(size=probs.shape[0])[:, None]
99	    return (u >= cum).sum(axis=1).astype(int)

102	def gen_confounding(K, N, p, rng):
103	    A = rng.choice(K, size=N, p=p['p_A'])
104	    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
105	    for j in range(K - 1):
106	        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1).astype(float)
107	    T = D @ p['alpha'] + rng.normal(0, p['sigma_T'], N)
108	    Y = p['beta_T'] * T + D @ p['beta_A'] + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
109	    return T, Y, A

112	def gen_mediation(K, N, p, rng):
113	    T = rng.binomial(1, 0.5, N).astype(float)
114	    logits = p['gamma'][None, :] + p['delta'][None, :] * T[:, None]
115	    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
116	    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
117	    for j in range(K - 1):
118	        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1)
119	    Y = p['beta'][0] + D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['tau'] * T + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
120	    return T, Y, A

123	def gen_collider(K, N, p, rng):
124	    T = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
125	    Y = p['tau'] * T + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
126	    logits = (p['g'][None, :] + p['dT'][None, :] * T[:, None]
127	              + p['dY'][None, :] * Y[:, None])
128	    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
129	    return T, Y, A

132	def gen_exposure(K, N, p, rng):
133	    A = rng.choice(K, size=N, p=p['p_A'])
134	    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
135	    for j in range(K - 1):
136	        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1).astype(float)
137	    Y = p['beta'][0] + D @ p['beta'][1:] + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
138	    return None, Y, A

141	def gen_mbias(K, N, p, rng):
142	    U1 = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
143	    U2 = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
144	    T = p['delta_coef'] * U1 + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
145	    Y = p['tau'] * T + p['lam'] * U2 + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
146	    logits = np.zeros((N, K))
147	    for j in range(1, K):
148	        logits[:, j] = p['g'][j] + p['a1'][j] * U1 + p['a2'][j] * U2
149	    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
150	    return T, Y, A

153	def gen_iv(K, N, p, rng):
154	    Z = rng.binomial(1, 0.5, N).astype(float)
155	    U = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
156	    eps = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
157	    logits = np.zeros((N, K))
158	    for j in range(1, K):
159	        logits[:, j] = p['g'][j] + p['dZ'][j] * Z + p['dU'][j] * U
160	    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
161	    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
162	    for j in range(K - 1):
163	        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1).astype(float)
164	    Y = D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['lam'] * U + eps
165	    return Z, Y, A

168	def gen_frontdoor(K, N, p, rng):
169	    U = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
170	    T = p['alpha_U'] * U + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
171	    logits = np.zeros((N, K))
172	    for j in range(1, K):
173	        logits[:, j] = p['gamma'][j] + p['delta'][j] * T
174	    M = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
175	    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
176	    for j in range(K - 1):
177	        D[:, j] = (M == j + 1).astype(float)
178	    Y = D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['lam_U'] * U + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
179	    return T, Y, M

187	# ====================================================================
188	# Sufficient Statistics
189	# ====================================================================
190	class SuffStats:
191	    def __init__(self, T, Y, A, K):
192	        self.K = K
193	        self.has_T = T is not None
194	        N = len(Y)
195	        DA = np.zeros((N, K))
196	        for k in range(K):
197	            DA[:, k] = (A == k).astype(float)
198	        self.p_A = DA.mean(0)
199	        self.E_Y = Y.mean()
200	        self.E_YD = (DA * Y[:, None]).mean(0)
201	        if self.has_T:
202	            self.E_T = T.mean()
203	            self.E_T2 = (T ** 2).mean()
204	            self.E_TY = (T * Y).mean()
205	            self.E_TD = (DA * T[:, None]).mean(0)
206	
207	
208	class IVSuffStats:
209	    def __init__(self, Z, Y, A, K):
210	        self.K = K
211	        z1 = Z == 1
212	        z0 = Z == 0
213	        self.RF = Y[z1].mean() - Y[z0].mean()
214	        self.FS = np.zeros(K)
215	        for k in range(K):
216	            self.FS[k] = (A[z1] == k).mean() - (A[z0] == k).mean()

219	# ====================================================================
220	# Plim computation (single C)
221	# ====================================================================
222	def plim_ols_with_T(C, ss):
223	    K = ss.K
224	    q = C @ ss.p_A
225	    ct = C @ ss.E_TD
226	    cy = C @ ss.E_YD
227	    dim = K + 1
228	    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
229	    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
230	    EZZ[0, 1] = ss.E_T
231	    EZZ[1, 0] = ss.E_T
232	    EZZ[1, 1] = ss.E_T2
233	    EZZ[0, 2:] = q[1:]
234	    EZZ[2:, 0] = q[1:]
235	    EZZ[1, 2:] = ct[1:]
236	    EZZ[2:, 1] = ct[1:]
237	    for j in range(K - 1):
238	        EZZ[j + 2, j + 2] = q[j + 1]
239	    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
240	    EZY[0] = ss.E_Y
241	    EZY[1] = ss.E_TY
242	    EZY[2:] = cy[1:]
243	    try:
244	        return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)
245	    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
246	        return np.full(dim, np.nan)
247	
248	
249	def plim_ols_exposure(C, ss):
250	    K = ss.K
251	    q = C @ ss.p_A
252	    cy = C @ ss.E_YD
253	    dim = K
254	    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
255	    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
256	    EZZ[0, 1:] = q[1:]
257	    EZZ[1:, 0] = q[1:]
258	    for j in range(K - 1):
259	        EZZ[j + 1, j + 1] = q[j + 1]
260	    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
261	    EZY[0] = ss.E_Y
262	    EZY[1:] = cy[1:]
263	    try:
264	        return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)
265	    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
266	        return np.full(dim, np.nan)
267	
268	
269	def plim_iv_single(C, ss):
270	    FS_star = C @ ss.FS
271	    if abs(FS_star[1]) < 1e-8:
272	        return np.nan
273	    return ss.RF / FS_star[1]

276	def get_tau_at_C(topo, C, ss):
277	    if topo == 'iv':
278	        return plim_iv_single(C, ss)
279	    elif topo == 'exposure':
280	        return plim_ols_exposure(C, ss)[1]
281	    else:
282	        return plim_ols_with_T(C, ss)[1]

285	def get_tau_true(topo, K, params, ss):
286	    """True causal parameter for Conjecture 1.
287	
288	    For correctly-identified topologies: tau_true = plim(I).
289	    For protective topologies (collider, mbias): tau_true = DGP tau,
290	    so B(0) = plim(I) - tau != 0 (Berkson/M-bias at perfect classification).
291	    """
292	    p = params[topo]
293	    if topo == 'collider':
294	        return p['tau']
295	    elif topo == 'mbias':
296	        return p['tau']
297	    else:
298	        return get_tau_at_C(topo, np.eye(K), ss)

301	# ====================================================================
302	# Batched bias curve computation
303	# ====================================================================
304	def compute_bias_curve(topo, C0, ss, tau_true, delta_step=DELTA_STEP):
305	    K = C0.shape[0]
306	    min_diag = np.diag(C0).min()
307	    if min_diag >= 1.0:
308	        delta_max = 10.0
309	    else:
310	        delta_max = min(1.0 / (1.0 - min_diag), 10.0)
311	
312	    deltas = np.arange(0, delta_max + delta_step / 2, delta_step)
313	    n = len(deltas)
314	    d = deltas[:, None]
315	
316	    if topo == 'iv':
317	        FS0 = C0 @ ss.FS
318	        fs_star = (1 - d) * ss.FS[None, :] + d * FS0[None, :]
319	        denom = fs_star[:, 1]
320	        taus = np.where(np.abs(denom) < 1e-8, np.nan, ss.RF / denom)
321	    elif topo == 'exposure':
322	        pA0 = C0 @ ss.p_A
323	        YD0 = C0 @ ss.E_YD
324	        q = (1 - d) * ss.p_A[None, :] + d * pA0[None, :]
325	        cy = (1 - d) * ss.E_YD[None, :] + d * YD0[None, :]
326	        dim = K
327	        EZZ = np.zeros((n, dim, dim))
328	        EZZ[:, 0, 0] = 1.0
329	        EZZ[:, 0, 1:] = q[:, 1:]
330	        EZZ[:, 1:, 0] = q[:, 1:]
331	        for j in range(K - 1):
332	            EZZ[:, j + 1, j + 1] = q[:, j + 1]
333	        EZY = np.zeros((n, dim))
334	        EZY[:, 0] = ss.E_Y
335	        EZY[:, 1:] = cy[:, 1:]
336	        try:
337	            coefs = np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY[..., np.newaxis])[..., 0]
338	            taus = coefs[:, 1]
339	        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
340	            taus = np.full(n, np.nan)
341	    else:
342	        pA0 = C0 @ ss.p_A
343	        TD0 = C0 @ ss.E_TD
344	        YD0 = C0 @ ss.E_YD
345	        q = (1 - d) * ss.p_A[None, :] + d * pA0[None, :]
346	        ct = (1 - d) * ss.E_TD[None, :] + d * TD0[None, :]
347	        cy = (1 - d) * ss.E_YD[None, :] + d * YD0[None, :]
348	        dim = K + 1
349	        EZZ = np.zeros((n, dim, dim))
350	        EZZ[:, 0, 0] = 1.0
351	        EZZ[:, 0, 1] = ss.E_T
352	        EZZ[:, 1, 0] = ss.E_T
353	        EZZ[:, 1, 1] = ss.E_T2
354	        EZZ[:, 0, 2:] = q[:, 1:]
355	        EZZ[:, 2:, 0] = q[:, 1:]
356	        EZZ[:, 1, 2:] = ct[:, 1:]
357	        EZZ[:, 2:, 1] = ct[:, 1:]
358	        for j in range(K - 1):
359	            EZZ[:, j + 2, j + 2] = q[:, j + 1]
360	        EZY = np.zeros((n, dim))
361	        EZY[:, 0] = ss.E_Y
362	        EZY[:, 1] = ss.E_TY
363	        EZY[:, 2:] = cy[:, 1:]
364	        try:
365	            coefs = np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY[..., np.newaxis])[..., 0]
366	            taus = coefs[:, 1]
367	        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
368	            taus = np.full(n, np.nan)
369	
370	    bias_abs = np.abs(taus - tau_true)
371	    return deltas, bias_abs
372

374	def check_monotonicity(bias_abs, topo, tol=MONO_TOL):
375	    valid = ~np.isnan(bias_abs)
376	    ba = bias_abs[valid]
377	    if len(ba) < 2:
378	        return 0
379	    diffs = np.diff(ba)
380	    if topo in NON_DECREASING:
381	        return int(np.sum(diffs < -tol))
382	    else:
383	        return int(np.sum(diffs > tol))

411	                ss = SuffStats(T, Y, A, K)

414	            tau_true = get_tau_true(topo, K, params, ss)
415	            all_ss[(topo, K)] = ss
416	            all_tau_true[(topo, K)] = tau_true
417	
418	    print("  Done ({:.1f}s). tau_true samples:".format(time.time() - t0))
419	    for topo in ALL_TOPOS:

421	        vals_s = ", ".join(

423	            for K, v in zip(K_VALUES, vals))
424	        direction = "non-dec" if topo in NON_DECREASING else "non-inc"
425	        print(f"    {topo:<14} [{direction}] {vals_s}")
426	    sys.stdout.flush()
427	    return all_ss, all_tau_true

434	    print("\n" + "=" * 70)

465	                _, bias_abs = compute_bias_curve(topo, C0, ss, tau_true)
466	
467	                n_nan = np.isnan(bias_abs).sum()
468	                if n_nan > len(bias_abs) * 0.5:
469	                    nan_curves += 1
470	                    continue
471	
472	                n_viol = check_monotonicity(bias_abs, topo)
473	                if n_viol > 0:
474	                    violations += 1
475	                    valid = ~np.isnan(bias_abs)
476	                    ba = bias_abs[valid]
477	                    diffs = np.diff(ba)
478	                    if topo in NON_DECREASING:
479	                        worst_mag = max(worst_mag, abs(diffs.min()))
480	                    else:
481	                        worst_mag = max(worst_mag, diffs.max())
482

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Exp-D: Conjecture 1 Extended Verification (Envelope Monotonicity)

Part 1: 10,000 random Dirichlet(1,...,1) C0 per (topology, K) -- 210,000 total tests
Part 2: Adversarial search via scipy.minimize for K in {3, 5} -- 500 starts per config

Conjecture 1:
  |B(delta)| non-decreasing for {confounding, mediation, exposure, frontdoor, iv}
  |B(delta)| non-increasing for {collider, mbias}

where B(delta) = plim(C(delta)) - tau_true, C(delta) = (1-delta)I + delta*C0.
"""

import numpy as np
import json
import time
import sys
import os
from scipy.optimize import minimize as scipy_minimize

# ====================================================================
# Configuration
# ====================================================================
K_VALUES = [3, 5, 7]
K_ADVERSARIAL = [3, 5]
N_RANDOM = 10_000
N_LARGE = 5_000_000
DELTA_STEP = 0.01
SEED = 12345
MONO_TOL = 1e-8

ALL_TOPOS = ['confounding', 'mediation', 'collider', 'exposure',
             'mbias', 'iv', 'frontdoor']
TOPO_IDX = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(ALL_TOPOS)}
NON_DECREASING = {'confounding', 'mediation', 'exposure', 'frontdoor', 'iv'}
NON_INCREASING = {'collider', 'mbias'}

ADV_DELTA_PAIRS = [(0.0, 0.2), (0.0, 0.5), (0.1, 0.3), (0.2, 0.5), (0.3, 0.7)]
ADV_N_STARTS = 100

OUT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))

# ====================================================================
# DGP Parameter Pools (from plan_002)
# ====================================================================
_ALPHA_POOL = [1.5, -1.0, 0.8, -0.5, 1.2, -0.7]
_BETA_A_POOL = [1.0, -0.5, 0.7, -0.3, 0.5, -0.2]
_BETA_POOL = [0.0, 1.0, -0.5, 0.7, -0.3, 0.5, -0.2]
_GAMMA_POOL = [0.0, 0.5, -0.3, 0.4, -0.2, 0.3, -0.1]
_DELTA_POOL = [0.0, 0.8, -0.6, 0.5, -0.4, 0.3, -0.2]
_DT_POOL = [0.0, 0.5, -0.3, 0.4, -0.2, 0.3, -0.1]
_DY_POOL = [0.0, 0.8, 0.6, -0.5, 0.4, -0.3, 0.2]
_MBIAS_A1_POOL = [0.0, 0.8, -0.5, 0.6, -0.4, 0.5, -0.3]
_MBIAS_A2_POOL = [0.0, 0.6, 0.9, -0.4, 0.7, -0.3, 0.5]
_IV_DZ_POOL = [0.0, 1.0, -0.5, 0.8, -0.4, 0.6, -0.3]
_IV_DU_POOL = [0.0, 0.8, 0.6, -0.5, 0.7, -0.3, 0.4]
_FD_GAMMA_POOL = [0.0, 0.5, -0.3, 0.4, -0.2, 0.3, -0.1]
_FD_DELTA_POOL = [0.0, 1.0, -0.8, 0.7, -0.5, 0.4, -0.3]


def make_p_A(K):
    if K == 3:
        return np.array([0.40, 0.35, 0.25])
    raw = np.array([1.0 / i for i in range(1, K + 1)])
    return raw / raw.sum()


def make_all_params(K):
    p_A = make_p_A(K)
    return dict(
        confounding=dict(p_A=p_A, alpha=np.array(_ALPHA_POOL[:K - 1]),
                         beta_A=np.array(_BETA_A_POOL[:K - 1]), beta_T=2.0, sigma_T=1.0),
        mediation=dict(tau=0.5, gamma=np.array(_GAMMA_POOL[:K]),
                       delta=np.array(_DELTA_POOL[:K]), beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K])),
        collider=dict(tau=1.0, g=np.zeros(K), dT=np.array(_DT_POOL[:K]),
                      dY=np.array(_DY_POOL[:K])),
        exposure=dict(beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K]), p_A=p_A),
        mbias=dict(tau=1.0, delta_coef=1.0, lam=1.0, g=np.zeros(K),
                   a1=np.array(_MBIAS_A1_POOL[:K]), a2=np.array(_MBIAS_A2_POOL[:K])),
        iv=dict(lam=1.0, g=np.zeros(K), dZ=np.array(_IV_DZ_POOL[:K]),
                dU=np.array(_IV_DU_POOL[:K]), beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K])),
        frontdoor=dict(alpha_U=1.0, lam_U=1.0, gamma=np.array(_FD_GAMMA_POOL[:K]),
                       delta=np.array(_FD_DELTA_POOL[:K]), beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K])),
    )


# ====================================================================
# DGP Generators (from plan_002)
# ====================================================================
def _softmax_rows(logits):
    e = np.exp(logits - logits.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    return e / e.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)


def _sample_cat(probs, rng):
    cum = np.cumsum(probs, axis=1)
    u = rng.uniform(size=probs.shape[0])[:, None]
    return (u >= cum).sum(axis=1).astype(int)


def gen_confounding(K, N, p, rng):
    A = rng.choice(K, size=N, p=p['p_A'])
    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
    for j in range(K - 1):
        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1).astype(float)
    T = D @ p['alpha'] + rng.normal(0, p['sigma_T'], N)
    Y = p['beta_T'] * T + D @ p['beta_A'] + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    return T, Y, A


def gen_mediation(K, N, p, rng):
    T = rng.binomial(1, 0.5, N).astype(float)
    logits = p['gamma'][None, :] + p['delta'][None, :] * T[:, None]
    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
    for j in range(K - 1):
        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1)
    Y = p['beta'][0] + D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['tau'] * T + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    return T, Y, A


def gen_collider(K, N, p, rng):
    T = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    Y = p['tau'] * T + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    logits = (p['g'][None, :] + p['dT'][None, :] * T[:, None]
              + p['dY'][None, :] * Y[:, None])
    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
    return T, Y, A


def gen_exposure(K, N, p, rng):
    A = rng.choice(K, size=N, p=p['p_A'])
    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
    for j in range(K - 1):
        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1).astype(float)
    Y = p['beta'][0] + D @ p['beta'][1:] + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    return None, Y, A


def gen_mbias(K, N, p, rng):
    U1 = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    U2 = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    T = p['delta_coef'] * U1 + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    Y = p['tau'] * T + p['lam'] * U2 + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    logits = np.zeros((N, K))
    for j in range(1, K):
        logits[:, j] = p['g'][j] + p['a1'][j] * U1 + p['a2'][j] * U2
    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
    return T, Y, A


def gen_iv(K, N, p, rng):
    Z = rng.binomial(1, 0.5, N).astype(float)
    U = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    eps = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    logits = np.zeros((N, K))
    for j in range(1, K):
        logits[:, j] = p['g'][j] + p['dZ'][j] * Z + p['dU'][j] * U
    A = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
    for j in range(K - 1):
        D[:, j] = (A == j + 1).astype(float)
    Y = D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['lam'] * U + eps
    return Z, Y, A


def gen_frontdoor(K, N, p, rng):
    U = rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    T = p['alpha_U'] * U + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    logits = np.zeros((N, K))
    for j in range(1, K):
        logits[:, j] = p['gamma'][j] + p['delta'][j] * T
    M = _sample_cat(_softmax_rows(logits), rng)
    D = np.zeros((N, K - 1))
    for j in range(K - 1):
        D[:, j] = (M == j + 1).astype(float)
    Y = D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['lam_U'] * U + rng.normal(0, 1, N)
    return T, Y, M


_GEN = dict(confounding=gen_confounding, mediation=gen_mediation,
            collider=gen_collider, exposure=gen_exposure,
            mbias=gen_mbias, iv=gen_iv, frontdoor=gen_frontdoor)


# ====================================================================
# Sufficient Statistics
# ====================================================================
class SuffStats:
    def __init__(self, T, Y, A, K):
        self.K = K
        self.has_T = T is not None
        N = len(Y)
        DA = np.zeros((N, K))
        for k in range(K):
            DA[:, k] = (A == k).astype(float)
        self.p_A = DA.mean(0)
        self.E_Y = Y.mean()
        self.E_YD = (DA * Y[:, None]).mean(0)
        if self.has_T:
            self.E_T = T.mean()
            self.E_T2 = (T ** 2).mean()
            self.E_TY = (T * Y).mean()
            self.E_TD = (DA * T[:, None]).mean(0)


class IVSuffStats:
    def __init__(self, Z, Y, A, K):
        self.K = K
        z1 = Z == 1
        z0 = Z == 0
        self.RF = Y[z1].mean() - Y[z0].mean()
        self.FS = np.zeros(K)
        for k in range(K):
            self.FS[k] = (A[z1] == k).mean() - (A[z0] == k).mean()


# ====================================================================
# Plim computation (single C)
# ====================================================================
def plim_ols_with_T(C, ss):
    K = ss.K
    q = C @ ss.p_A
    ct = C @ ss.E_TD
    cy = C @ ss.E_YD
    dim = K + 1
    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
    EZZ[0, 1] = ss.E_T
    EZZ[1, 0] = ss.E_T
    EZZ[1, 1] = ss.E_T2
    EZZ[0, 2:] = q[1:]
    EZZ[2:, 0] = q[1:]
    EZZ[1, 2:] = ct[1:]
    EZZ[2:, 1] = ct[1:]
    for j in range(K - 1):
        EZZ[j + 2, j + 2] = q[j + 1]
    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
    EZY[0] = ss.E_Y
    EZY[1] = ss.E_TY
    EZY[2:] = cy[1:]
    try:
        return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return np.full(dim, np.nan)


def plim_ols_exposure(C, ss):
    K = ss.K
    q = C @ ss.p_A
    cy = C @ ss.E_YD
    dim = K
    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
    EZZ[0, 1:] = q[1:]
    EZZ[1:, 0] = q[1:]
    for j in range(K - 1):
        EZZ[j + 1, j + 1] = q[j + 1]
    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
    EZY[0] = ss.E_Y
    EZY[1:] = cy[1:]
    try:
        return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return np.full(dim, np.nan)


def plim_iv_single(C, ss):
    FS_star = C @ ss.FS
    if abs(FS_star[1]) < 1e-8:
        return np.nan
    return ss.RF / FS_star[1]


def get_tau_at_C(topo, C, ss):
    if topo == 'iv':
        return plim_iv_single(C, ss)
    elif topo == 'exposure':
        return plim_ols_exposure(C, ss)[1]
    else:
        return plim_ols_with_T(C, ss)[1]


def get_tau_true(topo, K, params, ss):
    """True causal parameter for Conjecture 1.

    For correctly-identified topologies: tau_true = plim(I).
    For protective topologies (collider, mbias): tau_true = DGP tau,
    so B(0) = plim(I) - tau != 0 (Berkson/M-bias at perfect classification).
    """
    p = params[topo]
    if topo == 'collider':
        return p['tau']
    elif topo == 'mbias':
        return p['tau']
    else:
        return get_tau_at_C(topo, np.eye(K), ss)


# ====================================================================
# Batched bias curve computation
# ====================================================================
def compute_bias_curve(topo, C0, ss, tau_true, delta_step=DELTA_STEP):
    K = C0.shape[0]
    min_diag = np.diag(C0).min()
    if min_diag >= 1.0:
        delta_max = 10.0
    else:
        delta_max = min(1.0 / (1.0 - min_diag), 10.0)

    deltas = np.arange(0, delta_max + delta_step / 2, delta_step)
    n = len(deltas)
    d = deltas[:, None]

    if topo == 'iv':
        FS0 = C0 @ ss.FS
        fs_star = (1 - d) * ss.FS[None, :] + d * FS0[None, :]
        denom = fs_star[:, 1]
        taus = np.where(np.abs(denom) < 1e-8, np.nan, ss.RF / denom)
    elif topo == 'exposure':
        pA0 = C0 @ ss.p_A
        YD0 = C0 @ ss.E_YD
        q = (1 - d) * ss.p_A[None, :] + d * pA0[None, :]
        cy = (1 - d) * ss.E_YD[None, :] + d * YD0[None, :]
        dim = K
        EZZ = np.zeros((n, dim, dim))
        EZZ[:, 0, 0] = 1.0
        EZZ[:, 0, 1:] = q[:, 1:]
        EZZ[:, 1:, 0] = q[:, 1:]
        for j in range(K - 1):
            EZZ[:, j + 1, j + 1] = q[:, j + 1]
        EZY = np.zeros((n, dim))
        EZY[:, 0] = ss.E_Y
        EZY[:, 1:] = cy[:, 1:]
        try:
            coefs = np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY[..., np.newaxis])[..., 0]
            taus = coefs[:, 1]
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            taus = np.full(n, np.nan)
    else:
        pA0 = C0 @ ss.p_A
        TD0 = C0 @ ss.E_TD
        YD0 = C0 @ ss.E_YD
        q = (1 - d) * ss.p_A[None, :] + d * pA0[None, :]
        ct = (1 - d) * ss.E_TD[None, :] + d * TD0[None, :]
        cy = (1 - d) * ss.E_YD[None, :] + d * YD0[None, :]
        dim = K + 1
        EZZ = np.zeros((n, dim, dim))
        EZZ[:, 0, 0] = 1.0
        EZZ[:, 0, 1] = ss.E_T
        EZZ[:, 1, 0] = ss.E_T
        EZZ[:, 1, 1] = ss.E_T2
        EZZ[:, 0, 2:] = q[:, 1:]
        EZZ[:, 2:, 0] = q[:, 1:]
        EZZ[:, 1, 2:] = ct[:, 1:]
        EZZ[:, 2:, 1] = ct[:, 1:]
        for j in range(K - 1):
            EZZ[:, j + 2, j + 2] = q[:, j + 1]
        EZY = np.zeros((n, dim))
        EZY[:, 0] = ss.E_Y
        EZY[:, 1] = ss.E_TY
        EZY[:, 2:] = cy[:, 1:]
        try:
            coefs = np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY[..., np.newaxis])[..., 0]
            taus = coefs[:, 1]
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            taus = np.full(n, np.nan)

    bias_abs = np.abs(taus - tau_true)
    return deltas, bias_abs


def check_monotonicity(bias_abs, topo, tol=MONO_TOL):
    valid = ~np.isnan(bias_abs)
    ba = bias_abs[valid]
    if len(ba) < 2:
        return 0
    diffs = np.diff(ba)
    if topo in NON_DECREASING:
        return int(np.sum(diffs < -tol))
    else:
        return int(np.sum(diffs > tol))


# ====================================================================
# Precompute sufficient statistics
# ====================================================================
def precompute_all():
    print("\nPrecomputing sufficient statistics (N={:,})...".format(N_LARGE))
    sys.stdout.flush()
    t0 = time.time()
    all_ss = {}
    all_tau_true = {}

    for K in K_VALUES:
        params = make_all_params(K)
        for topo in ALL_TOPOS:
            rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED + K * 100 + TOPO_IDX[topo])
            p = params[topo]
            if topo == 'iv':
                Z, Y, A = gen_iv(K, N_LARGE, p, rng)
                ss = IVSuffStats(Z, Y, A, K)
                del Z, Y, A
            elif topo == 'exposure':
                _, Y, A = gen_exposure(K, N_LARGE, p, rng)
                ss = SuffStats(None, Y, A, K)
                del Y, A
            else:
                T, Y, A = _GEN[topo](K, N_LARGE, p, rng)
                ss = SuffStats(T, Y, A, K)
                del T, Y, A

            tau_true = get_tau_true(topo, K, params, ss)
            all_ss[(topo, K)] = ss
            all_tau_true[(topo, K)] = tau_true

    print("  Done ({:.1f}s). tau_true samples:".format(time.time() - t0))
    for topo in ALL_TOPOS:
        vals = [all_tau_true[(topo, K)] for K in K_VALUES]
        vals_s = ", ".join(
            f"K{K}={v:.6f}" if v is not None and not np.isnan(v) else f"K{K}=NaN"
            for K, v in zip(K_VALUES, vals))
        direction = "non-dec" if topo in NON_DECREASING else "non-inc"
        print(f"    {topo:<14} [{direction}] {vals_s}")
    sys.stdout.flush()
    return all_ss, all_tau_true


# ====================================================================
# Part 1: Random Verification
# ====================================================================
def part1_random(all_ss, all_tau_true):
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print("PART 1: Random Verification ({:,} C0 per topology x K)".format(N_RANDOM))
    print("=" * 70)
    sys.stdout.flush()

    results = {}
    total_tests = 0
    total_violations = 0

    for K in K_VALUES:
        print(f"\n  K = {K}")
        print(f"  {'Topology':<14} {'Direction':<10} {'Tested':>8} "
              f"{'Violations':>11} {'NaN_curves':>11} {'Time':>7}")
        print(f"  {'-' * 65}")
        sys.stdout.flush()

        for topo in ALL_TOPOS:
            t0 = time.time()
            ss = all_ss[(topo, K)]
            tau_true = all_tau_true[(topo, K)]

            rng_C = np.random.default_rng(SEED * 2 + K * 1000 + TOPO_IDX[topo])
            violations = 0
            nan_curves = 0
            worst_mag = 0.0

            for i in range(N_RANDOM):
                C0 = np.zeros((K, K))
                for j in range(K):
                    C0[:, j] = rng_C.dirichlet(np.ones(K))

                _, bias_abs = compute_bias_curve(topo, C0, ss, tau_true)

                n_nan = np.isnan(bias_abs).sum()
                if n_nan > len(bias_abs) * 0.5:
                    nan_curves += 1
                    continue

                n_viol = check_monotonicity(bias_abs, topo)
                if n_viol > 0:
                    violations += 1
                    valid = ~np.isnan(bias_abs)
                    ba = bias_abs[valid]
                    diffs = np.diff(ba)
                    if topo in NON_DECREASING:
                        worst_mag = max(worst_mag, abs(diffs.min()))
                    else:
                        worst_mag = max(worst_mag, diffs.max())

            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            direction = "non-dec" if topo in NON_DECREASING else "non-inc"
            print(f"  {topo:<14} {direction:<10} {N_RANDOM:>8} "
                  f"{violations:>11} {nan_curves:>11} {elapsed:>6.1f}s")
            sys.stdout.flush()

            results[f"{topo}_K{K}"] = {
                "n_tested": N_RANDOM,
                "violations": violations,
                "nan_curves": nan_curves,
                "direction": direction,
                "worst_violation_magnitude": float(worst_mag),
                "tau_true": float(tau_true) if not np.isnan(tau_true) else None,
            }
            total_tests += N_RANDOM
            total_violations += violations

    print(f"\n  Grand total: {total_tests:,} tests, {total_violations} violations")
    return results


# ====================================================================
# Part 2: Adversarial Search
# ====================================================================
def part2_adversarial(all_ss, all_tau_true):
    print("\n" + "=" * 70)
    print(f"PART 2: Adversarial Search ({ADV_N_STARTS} starts x "
          f"{len(ADV_DELTA_PAIRS)} delta-pairs)")
    print("=" * 70)
    sys.stdout.flush()

    results = {}

    for K in K_ADVERSARIAL:
        print(f"\n  K = {K}")
        print(f"  {'Topology':<14} {'Direction':<10} {'best_obj':>11} "
              f"{'Counterex':>11} {'Time':>7}")
        print(f"  {'-' * 57}")
        sys.stdout.flush()

        for topo in ALL_TOPOS:
            t0 = time.time()
            ss = all_ss[(topo, K)]
            tau_true = all_tau_true[(topo, K)]

            best_objective = np.inf
            found_counterexample = False
            rng_adv = np.random.default_rng(
                SEED * 3 + K * 10000 + TOPO_IDX[topo] * 100)

            for d1, d2 in ADV_DELTA_PAIRS:
                for _ in range(ADV_N_STARTS):
                    theta0 = rng_adv.normal(0, 1, K * K)

                    def objective(theta, _topo=topo, _ss=ss, _tt=tau_true,
                                  _d1=d1, _d2=d2, _K=K):
                        logits = theta.reshape(_K, _K)
                        exp_l = np.exp(logits - logits.max(axis=0, keepdims=True))
                        C0 = exp_l / exp_l.sum(axis=0, keepdims=True)

                        C1 = (1 - _d1) * np.eye(_K) + _d1 * C0
                        C2 = (1 - _d2) * np.eye(_K) + _d2 * C0

                        tau1 = get_tau_at_C(_topo, C1, _ss)
                        tau2 = get_tau_at_C(_topo, C2, _ss)

                        if np.isnan(tau1) or np.isnan(tau2):
                            return 0.0

                        b1_sq = (tau1 - _tt) ** 2
                        b2_sq = (tau2 - _tt) ** 2

                        if _topo in NON_DECREASING:
                            return b2_sq - b1_sq
                        else:
                            return b1_sq - b2_sq

                    res = scipy_minimize(objective, theta0, method='L-BFGS-B',
                                         options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-12})

                    if res.fun < best_objective:
                        best_objective = res.fun

                    if res.fun < -1e-6:
                        found_counterexample = True

            elapsed = time.time() - t0
            direction = "non-dec" if topo in NON_DECREASING else "non-inc"
            ce_str = "YES!" if found_counterexample else "no"
            print(f"  {topo:<14} {direction:<10} {best_objective:>11.6f} "
                  f"{ce_str:>11} {elapsed:>6.1f}s")
            sys.stdout.flush()

            results[f"{topo}_K{K}"] = {
                "n_starts": ADV_N_STARTS * len(ADV_DELTA_PAIRS),
                "best_objective": float(best_objective),
                "found_counterexample": found_counterexample,
                "delta_pairs": [[d1, d2] for d1, d2 in ADV_DELTA_PAIRS],
            }

    return results


# ====================================================================
# Main
# ====================================================================
def main():
    t_total = time.time()
    print("Exp-D: Conjecture 1 Extended Verification")
    print(f"  Random: {N_RANDOM:,} C0 x 7 topologies x K in {K_VALUES}")
    print(f"  Adversarial: {ADV_N_STARTS} starts x {len(ADV_DELTA_PAIRS)} "
          f"delta-pairs x K in {K_ADVERSARIAL}")
    print(f"  N_large={N_LARGE:,}, delta_step={DELTA_STEP}, seed={SEED}")
    sys.stdout.flush()

    all_ss, all_tau_true = precompute_all()

    random_results = part1_random(all_ss, all_tau_true)
    adversarial_results = part2_adversarial(all_ss, all_tau_true)

    # Build output
    total_random = sum(r['n_tested'] for r in random_results.values())
    total_viol = sum(r['violations'] for r in random_results.values())
    total_ce = sum(1 for r in adversarial_results.values()
                   if r['found_counterexample'])

    if total_viol == 0 and total_ce == 0:
        summary = (f"Zero violations across {total_random:,} random tests + "
                   f"0 counterexamples found by adversarial search")
    else:
        summary = (f"{total_viol} violations across {total_random:,} random tests + "
                   f"{total_ce} counterexamples found by adversarial search")

    output = {"random_verification": {}, "adversarial_search": {}, "summary": summary}

    for topo in ALL_TOPOS:
        rv = {}
        for K in K_VALUES:
            key = f"{topo}_K{K}"
            if key in random_results:
                rv[f"K{K}"] = random_results[key]
        output["random_verification"][topo] = rv

    for topo in ALL_TOPOS:
        av = {}
        for K in K_ADVERSARIAL:
            key = f"{topo}_K{K}"
            if key in adversarial_results:
                av[f"K{K}"] = adversarial_results[key]
        output["adversarial_search"][topo] = av

    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, 'exp_d_conjecture_results.json')
    with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
        json.dump(output, f, indent=2, default=str)
    print(f"\nJSON -> {out_path}")

    total_time = time.time() - t_total
    print(f"\n{summary}")
    print(f"Total time: {total_time:.0f}s ({total_time/60:.1f}min)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Compute annotation-error bias via probability limit calculations.

Uses precomputed sufficient statistics from large-sample DGP simulations
to compute OLS plim as a function of confusion matrix C, avoiding MC.
"""

import warnings
import numpy as np
from .dgp import DEFAULT_PARAMS, HAS_TREATMENT, GEN_FUNCS, TOPOLOGIES
from .confusion import validate_confusion_matrix

_N_PRECOMP = 2_000_000
_precomp_cache = {}


def _params_key(params):
    items = []
    for k, v in sorted(params.items()):
        if isinstance(v, np.ndarray):
            items.append((k, tuple(v.flat)))
        else:
            items.append((k, v))
    return tuple(items)


def _precompute(topology, params, K, seed=999):
    """Precompute sufficient statistics for plim calculation."""
    cache_key = (topology, _params_key(params), K)
    if cache_key in _precomp_cache:
        return _precomp_cache[cache_key]

    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    data = GEN_FUNCS[topology](_N_PRECOMP, params=params, rng=rng)
    Y = data["Y"]
    A = data["A"]

    DA = np.zeros((_N_PRECOMP, K))
    for k in range(K):
        DA[:, k] = (A == k).astype(float)

    stats = {
        "E_Y": Y.mean(),
        "E_DA": DA.mean(0),
        "E_DA_Y": (DA * Y[:, None]).mean(0),
    }

    if topology in HAS_TREATMENT:
        T = data["T"]
        stats.update({
            "E_T": T.mean(),
            "E_T2": (T ** 2).mean(),
            "E_TY": (T * Y).mean(),
            "E_DA_T": (DA * T[:, None]).mean(0),
        })

    if topology == "iv":
        Z = data["Z"]
        Zc = Z - Z.mean()
        var_Z = (Zc ** 2).mean()
        stats["RF"] = (Zc * (Y - Y.mean())).mean() / var_Z
        FS = np.zeros(K)
        for k in range(K):
            FS[k] = (Zc * (DA[:, k] - DA[:, k].mean())).mean() / var_Z
        stats["FS"] = FS

    _precomp_cache[cache_key] = stats
    return stats


def _plim_with_T(C, stats, K):
    """OLS plim for Y ~ 1 + T + D*_1 + ... + D*_{K-1}."""
    ds = C @ stats["E_DA"]
    dst = C @ stats["E_DA_T"]
    dsy = C @ stats["E_DA_Y"]
    ET, ET2 = stats["E_T"], stats["E_T2"]
    EY, ETY = stats["E_Y"], stats["E_TY"]

    dim = 1 + K  # intercept + T + (K-1) dummies
    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
    EZZ[0, 1] = EZZ[1, 0] = ET
    EZZ[1, 1] = ET2
    for j in range(1, K):
        idx = j + 1
        EZZ[0, idx] = EZZ[idx, 0] = ds[j]
        EZZ[1, idx] = EZZ[idx, 1] = dst[j]
        EZZ[idx, idx] = ds[j]

    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
    EZY[0] = EY
    EZY[1] = ETY
    for j in range(1, K):
        EZY[j + 1] = dsy[j]

    cond = np.linalg.cond(EZZ)
    if cond > 1e12:
        warnings.warn(
            f"EZZ condition number {cond:.1e} — plim may be numerically unstable"
        )

    return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)


def _plim_no_T(C, stats, K):
    """OLS plim for Y ~ 1 + D*_1 + ... + D*_{K-1}."""
    ds = C @ stats["E_DA"]
    dsy = C @ stats["E_DA_Y"]
    EY = stats["E_Y"]

    dim = K  # intercept + (K-1) dummies
    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
    for j in range(1, K):
        EZZ[0, j] = EZZ[j, 0] = ds[j]
        EZZ[j, j] = ds[j]

    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
    EZY[0] = EY
    for j in range(1, K):
        EZY[j] = dsy[j]

    cond = np.linalg.cond(EZZ)
    if cond > 1e12:
        warnings.warn(
            f"EZZ condition number {cond:.1e} — plim may be numerically unstable"
        )

    return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)


def _plim_iv(C, stats, K):
    """Wald estimator plim: RF / (C @ FS)[1]."""
    FS_star = C @ stats["FS"]
    denom = FS_star[1]
    if abs(denom) < 1e-15:
        return np.nan
    return stats["RF"] / denom


def _get_tau(topology, C, stats, K):
    """Extract target coefficient from plim vector.

    For IV: Wald estimator RF / (C @ FS)[1].
    For topologies with T: OLS coefficient index 1 (treatment effect).
    For topologies without T: OLS coefficient index 1 (first dummy).
    """
    if topology == "iv":
        return _plim_iv(C, stats, K)
    if topology in HAS_TREATMENT:
        coefs = _plim_with_T(C, stats, K)
    else:
        coefs = _plim_no_T(C, stats, K)
    return coefs[1]


def compute_bias(topology, C, params=None):
    """Compute annotation-error bias for a given topology and confusion matrix.

    Args:
        topology: one of "confounding", "mediation", "collider", "exposure",
                  "mbias", "iv", "frontdoor"
        C: (K, K) column-stochastic confusion matrix, C[j,i] = P(A*=j|A=i)
        params: optional DGP parameters dict, None uses defaults

    Returns:
        dict with tau_true, tau_biased, bias, bias_pct, topology
    """
    if topology not in TOPOLOGIES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown topology: {topology}. Choose from {TOPOLOGIES}")
    if not validate_confusion_matrix(C):
        raise ValueError("C must be a square, non-negative, column-stochastic matrix")

    K = C.shape[0]
    merged = dict(DEFAULT_PARAMS[topology])
    if params is not None:
        merged.update(params)

    stats = _precompute(topology, merged, K)
    tau_true = _get_tau(topology, np.eye(K), stats, K)
    tau_biased = _get_tau(topology, C, stats, K)
    bias = tau_biased - tau_true
    bias_pct = 100.0 * bias / tau_true if abs(tau_true) > 1e-12 else float("nan")

    return {
        "tau_true": float(tau_true),
        "tau_biased": float(tau_biased),
        "bias": float(bias),
        "bias_pct": float(bias_pct),
        "topology": topology,
    }


def clear_cache():
    """Clear the precomputed statistics cache."""
    _precomp_cache.clear()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Exp-D ε-sensitivity to τ: does the ε-approximate monotonicity bound depend
on the true effect size τ?

For each non-IV topology and τ ∈ {0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0}, sample 10,000
random Dirichlet(1,...,1) confusion matrices and compute:
  ε(C0) = (worst wrong-direction step in bias curve) / |τ_true|
where τ_true = plim of OLS at C=I (or DGP τ for collider/mbias).

The τ-related DGP parameter is set per topology:
  confounding:  beta_T = τ        (direct T→Y effect)
  mediation:    tau   = τ         (direct T→Y effect, T binary)
  collider:     tau   = τ         (DGP T→Y effect)
  mbias:        tau   = τ         (DGP T→Y effect)
  exposure:     beta *= τ         (no T; bias scales linearly => ε invariant)
  frontdoor:    beta *= τ         (M→Y effect; affine in τ)

Reports max_eps, mean_eps, p99_eps, and n_violations (where ε > 0.06).
Output: exp_d_epsilon_tau_sensitivity.json
"""

import numpy as np
import json
import time
import sys
import os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from exp_d_conjecture_verify_v2 import (
    K_VALUES, ALL_TOPOS, NON_DECREASING,
    _COMPUTE_SS, compute_bias_curve, get_tau_true,
    SEED, DELTA_STEP,
    _ALPHA_POOL, _BETA_A_POOL, _BETA_POOL,
    _GAMMA_POOL, _DELTA_POOL, _DT_POOL, _DY_POOL,
    _MBIAS_A1_POOL, _MBIAS_A2_POOL,
    _FD_GAMMA_POOL, _FD_DELTA_POOL,
    make_p_A,
)


TAU_VALUES = [0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0]
NON_IV_TOPOS = ['confounding', 'mediation', 'collider', 'exposure',
                'mbias', 'frontdoor']
EPS_THRESHOLD = 0.06
N_RAND_SENS = 10_000
OUT_DIR = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))


def make_params_with_tau(K, tau):
    p_A = make_p_A(K)
    tau = float(tau)
    return dict(
        confounding=dict(p_A=p_A, alpha=np.array(_ALPHA_POOL[:K - 1]),
                         beta_A=np.array(_BETA_A_POOL[:K - 1]),
                         beta_T=tau, sigma_T=1.0),
        mediation=dict(tau=tau, gamma=np.array(_GAMMA_POOL[:K]),
                       delta=np.array(_DELTA_POOL[:K]),
                       beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K])),
        collider=dict(tau=tau, g=np.zeros(K),
                      dT=np.array(_DT_POOL[:K]),
                      dY=np.array(_DY_POOL[:K])),
        exposure=dict(beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K]) * tau, p_A=p_A),
        mbias=dict(tau=tau, delta_coef=1.0, lam=1.0, g=np.zeros(K),
                   a1=np.array(_MBIAS_A1_POOL[:K]),
                   a2=np.array(_MBIAS_A2_POOL[:K])),
        frontdoor=dict(alpha_U=1.0, lam_U=1.0,
                       gamma=np.array(_FD_GAMMA_POOL[:K]),
                       delta=np.array(_FD_DELTA_POOL[:K]),
                       beta=np.array(_BETA_POOL[:K]) * tau),
    )


def wrong_direction_step(bias_abs, topo):
    """Largest single-step deviation in the wrong direction (absolute units)."""
    valid = ~np.isnan(bias_abs)
    ba = bias_abs[valid]
    if len(ba) < 2:
        return 0.0
    diffs = np.diff(ba)
    if topo in NON_DECREASING:
        return float(max(0.0, -diffs.min()))
    return float(max(0.0, diffs.max()))


def run_one_setting(topo, K, tau, n_random):
    params = make_params_with_tau(K, tau)
    ss = _COMPUTE_SS[topo](K, params[topo])
    tau_true = get_tau_true(topo, K, params, ss)
    if np.isnan(tau_true) or abs(tau_true) < 1e-12:
        return None, tau_true

    rng_C = np.random.default_rng(
        SEED * 7 + K * 1_000_003 + ALL_TOPOS.index(topo) * 10_007
        + int(round(tau * 1000))
    )
    eps = np.empty(n_random)
    for i in range(n_random):
        C0 = np.empty((K, K))
        for j in range(K):
            C0[:, j] = rng_C.dirichlet(np.ones(K))
        _, bias_abs = compute_bias_curve(topo, C0, ss, tau_true)
        eps[i] = wrong_direction_step(bias_abs, topo) / abs(tau_true)
    return eps, float(tau_true)


def main():
    t_total = time.time()
    print("=" * 78)
    print("Exp-D ε(τ) sensitivity")
    print(f"  Non-IV topologies: {NON_IV_TOPOS}")
    print(f"  τ values: {TAU_VALUES}")
    print(f"  K values: {K_VALUES}")
    print(f"  N random C0 per (topo, K, τ): {N_RAND_SENS:,}")
    print(f"  ε threshold for 'violation' count: {EPS_THRESHOLD}")
    print("=" * 78)
    sys.stdout.flush()

    results = {}
    for topo in NON_IV_TOPOS:
        results[topo] = {}
        print(f"\n[{topo}]")
        print(f"  {'τ':>6}  {'τ_true':>12}  {'max_eps':>10}  {'p99_eps':>10}  "
              f"{'mean_eps':>10}  {'n_viol':>10}  {'K':>3}  {'time':>7}")
        sys.stdout.flush()
        for tau in TAU_VALUES:
            tau_key = f"tau_{tau}"
            per_K = {}
            for K in K_VALUES:
                t0 = time.time()
                eps, tau_true = run_one_setting(topo, K, tau, N_RAND_SENS)
                elapsed = time.time() - t0
                if eps is None:
                    per_K[f"K{K}"] = {
                        "tau_true": tau_true,
                        "error": "tau_true is NaN or zero",
                    }
                    print(f"  {tau:>6}  {'NaN':>12}  {'-':>10}  {'-':>10}  "
                          f"{'-':>10}  {'-':>10}  {K:>3}  {elapsed:>6.1f}s")
                    sys.stdout.flush()
                    continue
                rec = {
                    "tau_true": tau_true,
                    "max_eps": float(eps.max()),
                    "p99_eps": float(np.percentile(eps, 99)),
                    "mean_eps": float(eps.mean()),
                    "n_violations": int((eps > EPS_THRESHOLD).sum()),
                    "n_tested": N_RAND_SENS,
                }
                per_K[f"K{K}"] = rec
                print(f"  {tau:>6}  {tau_true:>12.6f}  {rec['max_eps']:>10.4f}  "
                      f"{rec['p99_eps']:>10.4f}  {rec['mean_eps']:>10.4f}  "
                      f"{rec['n_violations']:>10}  {K:>3}  {elapsed:>6.1f}s")
                sys.stdout.flush()

            agg_keys = [k for k in per_K if "error" not in per_K[k]]
            if agg_keys:
                agg = {
                    "max_eps": max(per_K[k]["max_eps"] for k in agg_keys),
                    "p99_eps": max(per_K[k]["p99_eps"] for k in agg_keys),
                    "mean_eps": float(np.mean([per_K[k]["mean_eps"]
                                                for k in agg_keys])),
                    "n_violations": sum(per_K[k]["n_violations"]
                                         for k in agg_keys),
                    "n_tested": sum(per_K[k]["n_tested"] for k in agg_keys),
                }
            else:
                agg = {"error": "no valid K"}
            results[topo][tau_key] = {
                "aggregate_over_K": agg,
                "per_K": per_K,
            }

    elapsed_total = time.time() - t_total
    out = {
        "tau_values": TAU_VALUES,
        "topologies": NON_IV_TOPOS,
        "K_values": K_VALUES,
        "n_random_per_setting": N_RAND_SENS,
        "eps_threshold": EPS_THRESHOLD,
        "seed_base": SEED,
        "delta_step": DELTA_STEP,
        "tau_param_mapping": {
            "confounding": "beta_T = tau",
            "mediation": "tau (T->Y direct)",
            "collider": "tau (T->Y direct)",
            "exposure": "beta *= tau (linear in tau; eps invariant)",
            "mbias": "tau (T->Y direct)",
            "frontdoor": "beta *= tau (affine in tau)",
        },
        "results": results,
        "elapsed_seconds": elapsed_total,
    }
    out_path = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, "exp_d_epsilon_tau_sensitivity.json")
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2, default=str)

    print("\n" + "=" * 78)
    print(f"Total time: {elapsed_total:.1f}s ({elapsed_total/60:.1f}min)")
    print(f"Saved -> {out_path}")
    print("=" * 78)

    # Summary table: max_eps across τ per topology
    print("\nSummary -- max ε across K, per (topology, τ):")
    print(f"  {'topology':<14}  " + "  ".join(f"τ={t:<5}" for t in TAU_VALUES))
    for topo in NON_IV_TOPOS:
        row = [topo.ljust(14)]
        for tau in TAU_VALUES:
            rec = results[topo].get(f"tau_{tau}", {}).get("aggregate_over_K", {})
            v = rec.get("max_eps", float("nan"))
            row.append(f"{v:>7.4f}")
        print("  " + "  ".join(row))

    print("\nSummary -- n_violations (ε > 0.06) across K, per (topology, τ):")
    print(f"  {'topology':<14}  " + "  ".join(f"τ={t:<5}" for t in TAU_VALUES))
    for topo in NON_IV_TOPOS:
        row = [topo.ljust(14)]
        for tau in TAU_VALUES:
            rec = results[topo].get(f"tau_{tau}", {}).get("aggregate_over_K", {})
            v = rec.get("n_violations", "-")
            row.append(f"{str(v):>7}")
        print("  " + "  ".join(row))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

5	The original exp_d_conjecture_verify.py computed plim via sufficient statistics
6	estimated from N=5M Monte Carlo simulation, introducing O(1/sqrt(N)) ~ 0.0004
7	sampling noise. At MONO_TOL=1e-8, this generated ~141k false monotonicity
8	violations.
9	
10	This v2 computes ALL sufficient statistics analytically (closed-form for
11	confounding/mediation/exposure, Gauss-Hermite quadrature for collider/mbias/
12	frontdoor/iv), eliminating sampling noise entirely.
13	
14	Topology-specific analytics:
15	  - confounding: fully analytic (categorical A, linear T and Y)
16	  - exposure:    fully analytic (categorical A, linear Y)
17	  - mediation:   fully analytic (binary T, softmax A|T, linear Y)
18	  - collider:    2D Gauss-Hermite over (T, eps_Y), both N(0,1)
19	  - mbias:       2D Gauss-Hermite over (U1, U2), both N(0,1)
20	  - frontdoor:   1D Gauss-Hermite over T ~ N(0, alpha_U^2 + 1)
21	  - iv:          1D Gauss-Hermite over U ~ N(0,1), with binary Z
22	
23	Output: exp_d_conjecture_results_v2.json (same structure as v1)
24	"""

35	# Gauss-Hermite quadrature setup
36	# ====================================================================
37	N_GH = 100  # points per dimension -- machine precision for smooth integrands
38	
39	# roots_hermite: physicist's convention, weight = exp(-x^2)
40	# integral f(x) exp(-x^2) dx ~ sum w_i f(x_i)
41	# For N(0,1) expectation: E[f(X)] = (1/sqrt(pi)) sum w_i f(x_i * sqrt(2))
42	_gh_x_raw, _gh_w_raw = roots_hermite(N_GH)
43	GH_X = _gh_x_raw * np.sqrt(2)   # rescaled nodes for N(0,1)
44	GH_W = _gh_w_raw / np.sqrt(np.pi)  # rescaled weights: sum w_i f(x_i) = E_{N(0,1)}[f]
45	
46	# Verify: E[1] should be 1.0, E[X^2] should be 1.0
47	assert abs(GH_W.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-12, f"GH weights sum to {GH_W.sum()}, expected 1.0"
48	assert abs((GH_W * GH_X**2).sum() - 1.0) < 1e-10, "GH E[X^2] != 1.0"
49	
50	# 2D quadrature: outer product of 1D grids
51	GH_X2_a, GH_X2_b = np.meshgrid(GH_X, GH_X, indexing='ij')  # (N_GH, N_GH)
52	GH_W2 = np.outer(GH_W, GH_W)  # (N_GH, N_GH)
53	GH_X2_a_flat = GH_X2_a.ravel()
54	GH_X2_b_flat = GH_X2_b.ravel()
55	GH_W2_flat = GH_W2.ravel()

125	def _softmax(logits):
126	    """Softmax along last axis, numerically stable."""
127	    e = np.exp(logits - np.max(logits, axis=-1, keepdims=True))
128	    return e / np.sum(e, axis=-1, keepdims=True)

134	class AnalyticSuffStats:
135	    """Population moments for OLS topologies (with or without T)."""
136	    def __init__(self, K, has_T=True):
137	        self.K = K
138	        self.has_T = has_T
139	        self.p_A = None   # K-vector: P(A=k)
140	        self.E_Y = None   # scalar
141	        self.E_YD = None  # K-vector: E[Y * 1(A=k)]
142	        if has_T:
143	            self.E_T = None   # scalar
144	            self.E_T2 = None  # scalar: E[T^2]
145	            self.E_TY = None  # scalar: E[T*Y]
146	            self.E_TD = None  # K-vector: E[T * 1(A=k)]
147

149	class AnalyticIVSuffStats:
150	    """Population moments for IV topology (Wald estimator)."""
151	    def __init__(self, K):
152	        self.K = K
153	        self.RF = None   # E[Y|Z=1] - E[Y|Z=0]
154	        self.FS = None   # K-vector: P(A=k|Z=1) - P(A=k|Z=0)

157	# ====================================================================
158	# Topology 1: Confounding -- FULLY ANALYTIC
159	# ====================================================================
160	# DGP: A ~ Cat(p_A), T = sum_{j=1}^{K-1} alpha_j D_j + eps_T,
161	#       Y = beta_T * T + sum_{j=1}^{K-1} beta_A_j D_j + eps_Y
162	# D_j = 1(A=j+1) for j=0,...,K-2 (ref category A=0)
163	# Wait -- looking at original code more carefully:
164	#   D[:, j] = (A == j + 1) for j in range(K-1)
165	# So D_j = 1(A = j+1), j=0,...,K-2
166	# T = D @ alpha + eps_T = sum_{j=0}^{K-2} alpha_j * 1(A=j+1) + eps_T
167	# Y = beta_T * T + D @ beta_A + eps_Y = beta_T * T + sum_{j=0}^{K-2} beta_A_j * 1(A=j+1) + eps_Y
168	#
169	# For the plim regression Y ~ 1 + T + D*_1 + ... + D*_{K-1}:
170	# D*_j = 1(A* = j) for j=1,...,K-1 (ref category A*=0)
171	# The sufficient stats use A (not A*), and the C matrix maps A->A*.
172	# Actually looking at the SuffStats class: DA[:, k] = (A == k) for k=0,...,K-1
173	# So p_A[k] = P(A=k), E_TD[k] = E[T * 1(A=k)], E_YD[k] = E[Y * 1(A=k)]
174	
175	def compute_confounding_ss(K, p):
176	    """Analytic sufficient stats for confounding topology."""
177	    ss = AnalyticSuffStats(K, has_T=True)
178	    p_A = p['p_A']       # K-vector
179	    alpha = p['alpha']    # (K-1)-vector: alpha_0,...,alpha_{K-2}
180	    beta_A = p['beta_A']  # (K-1)-vector
181	    beta_T = p['beta_T']
182	    sigma_T = p['sigma_T']
183	
184	    ss.p_A = p_A.copy()
185	
186	    # E[T] = sum_{j=0}^{K-2} alpha_j * P(A=j+1)
187	    # (since eps_T has mean 0)
188	    ss.E_T = sum(alpha[j] * p_A[j + 1] for j in range(K - 1))
189	
190	    # E[T^2] = E[(sum alpha_j D_j)^2] + sigma_T^2
191	    # = sum_j alpha_j^2 P(A=j+1) + sigma_T^2
192	    # (since D_j D_k = 0 for j!=k, D_j^2 = D_j)
193	    ss.E_T2 = sum(alpha[j]**2 * p_A[j + 1] for j in range(K - 1)) + sigma_T**2
194	
195	    # E[T * 1(A=k)]:
196	    # For k=0: E[(sum alpha_j D_j + eps_T) * 1(A=0)]
197	    #        = sum_j alpha_j E[D_j * 1(A=0)] + E[eps_T * 1(A=0)]
198	    #        = 0 + 0 = 0  (since D_j=1(A=j+1) and A=0 => D_j=0, and eps_T indep of A)
199	    # Actually eps_T is independent of A, so E[eps_T * 1(A=k)] = 0 * P(A=k) = 0
200	    # For k>=1: E[(sum_j alpha_j D_j + eps_T) * 1(A=k)]
201	    #         = alpha_{k-1} * P(A=k) + 0
202	    ss.E_TD = np.zeros(K)
203	    for k in range(1, K):
204	        ss.E_TD[k] = alpha[k - 1] * p_A[k]
205	
206	    # E[Y] = beta_T * E[T] + sum_{j=0}^{K-2} beta_A_j * P(A=j+1)
207	    ss.E_Y = beta_T * ss.E_T + sum(beta_A[j] * p_A[j + 1] for j in range(K - 1))
208	
209	    # E[Y * 1(A=k)] = beta_T * E[T * 1(A=k)] + sum_j beta_A_j * E[D_j * 1(A=k)] + E[eps_Y * 1(A=k)]
210	    # E[D_j * 1(A=k)] = P(A=j+1, A=k) = P(A=k) if j+1=k else 0
211	    # E[eps_Y * 1(A=k)] = 0
212	    # So for k=0: E[Y * 1(A=0)] = beta_T * 0 + 0 + 0 = 0 ... wait that's wrong
213	    # Actually: Y = beta_T * T + sum beta_A_j D_j + eps_Y
214	    # E[Y * 1(A=0)] = beta_T * E[T * 1(A=0)] + sum_j beta_A_j * E[D_j * 1(A=0)] + E[eps_Y * 1(A=0)]
215	    #               = beta_T * 0 + 0 + 0 = 0
216	    # Hmm, that gives E_Y = sum_k E[Y * 1(A=k)] = 0 + sum_{k>=1} stuff, but we need E_Y correctly.
217	    # Let me reconsider: the intercept in the Y equation.
218	    # gen_confounding: Y = beta_T * T + D @ beta_A + eps_Y
219	    # There's no explicit intercept in Y. So E[Y | A=0] = beta_T * E[T | A=0] + 0
220	    # E[T | A=0] = 0 (since all alpha terms vanish) + E[eps_T] = 0
221	    # So E[Y * 1(A=0)] = E[Y | A=0] * P(A=0) = 0 * p_A[0] = 0
222	    # That seems correct.
223	
224	    # For k >= 1:
225	    # E[Y * 1(A=k)] = beta_T * E[T * 1(A=k)] + beta_A[k-1] * P(A=k)
226	    ss.E_YD = np.zeros(K)
227	    for k in range(1, K):
228	        ss.E_YD[k] = beta_T * ss.E_TD[k] + beta_A[k - 1] * p_A[k]
229	    # k=0: already 0
230	
231	    # E[TY] = E[T * (beta_T * T + sum beta_A_j D_j + eps_Y)]
232	    #        = beta_T * E[T^2] + sum_j beta_A_j * E[T * D_j] + E[T * eps_Y]
233	    #        = beta_T * E[T^2] + sum_j beta_A_j * E[T * 1(A=j+1)] + 0
234	    ss.E_TY = beta_T * ss.E_T2 + sum(beta_A[j] * ss.E_TD[j + 1] for j in range(K - 1))
235	
236	    return ss

240	# Topology 2: Exposure -- FULLY ANALYTIC
241	# ====================================================================
242	# DGP: A ~ Cat(p_A), Y = beta[0] + D @ beta[1:] + eps_Y
243	# No T variable.
244	
245	def compute_exposure_ss(K, p):
246	    """Analytic sufficient stats for exposure topology."""
247	    ss = AnalyticSuffStats(K, has_T=False)
248	    p_A = p['p_A']
249	    beta = p['beta']  # K-vector: beta[0] is intercept
250	
251	    ss.p_A = p_A.copy()
252	
253	    # E[Y] = beta[0] + sum_{j=1}^{K-1} beta[j] * P(A=j)
254	    ss.E_Y = beta[0] + sum(beta[j] * p_A[j] for j in range(1, K))
255	
256	    # E[Y * 1(A=k)] = E[(beta[0] + sum_j beta[j] D_j + eps_Y) * 1(A=k)]
257	    # = beta[0] * P(A=k) + beta[k] * P(A=k) (if k>=1) + 0
258	    # For k=0: = beta[0] * P(A=0) + 0 = beta[0] * p_A[0]
259	    ss.E_YD = np.zeros(K)
260	    ss.E_YD[0] = beta[0] * p_A[0]
261	    for k in range(1, K):
262	        ss.E_YD[k] = (beta[0] + beta[k]) * p_A[k]
263	
264	    return ss

267	# ====================================================================
268	# Topology 3: Mediation -- FULLY ANALYTIC (T is binary)
269	# ====================================================================
270	# DGP: T ~ Bern(0.5), A | T ~ Cat(softmax(gamma + delta * T))
271	#       Y = beta[0] + D @ beta[1:] + tau * T + eps_Y
272	# D_j = 1(A = j+1) for j=0,...,K-2
273	
274	def compute_mediation_ss(K, p):
275	    """Analytic sufficient stats for mediation topology."""
276	    ss = AnalyticSuffStats(K, has_T=True)
277	    tau = p['tau']
278	    gamma = p['gamma']  # K-vector
279	    delta_coef = p['delta']   # K-vector
280	    beta = p['beta']    # K-vector
281	
282	    # P(A=k | T=t) = softmax(gamma + delta * t)[k]
283	    probs_T0 = _softmax(gamma)          # K-vector
284	    probs_T1 = _softmax(gamma + delta_coef)  # K-vector
285	
286	    # P(A=k) = 0.5 * P(A=k|T=0) + 0.5 * P(A=k|T=1)
287	    ss.p_A = 0.5 * probs_T0 + 0.5 * probs_T1
288	
289	    # E[T] = 0.5, E[T^2] = 0.5 (since T is Bernoulli(0.5))
290	    ss.E_T = 0.5
291	    ss.E_T2 = 0.5
292	
293	    # E[T * 1(A=k)] = E[T * 1(A=k)]
294	    # = 0.5 * 0 * P(A=k|T=0) + 0.5 * 1 * P(A=k|T=1)
295	    # = 0.5 * probs_T1[k]
296	    ss.E_TD = 0.5 * probs_T1
297	
298	    # E[Y] = beta[0] + sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(A=k) + tau * E[T]
299	    # Wait, gen_mediation:
300	    #   Y = p['beta'][0] + D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['tau'] * T + eps_Y
301	    # D_j = 1(A=j+1), so D @ beta[1:] = sum_{j=0}^{K-2} beta[j+1] * 1(A=j+1)
302	    # = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * 1(A=k)
303	    ss.E_Y = beta[0] + sum(beta[k] * ss.p_A[k] for k in range(1, K)) + tau * 0.5
304	
305	    # E[Y * 1(A=k)] for each k:
306	    # Y = beta[0] + sum_j beta[j+1]*D_j + tau*T + eps_Y
307	    # E[Y * 1(A=k)] = E[(beta[0] + beta[k]*1(k>=1) + tau*T + eps_Y) * 1(A=k)]
308	    # = (beta[0] + beta[k]*(k>=1)) * P(A=k) + tau * E[T * 1(A=k)]
309	
310	    ss.E_YD = np.zeros(K)
311	    for k in range(K):
312	        beta_k = beta[k] if k >= 1 else 0.0
313	        ss.E_YD[k] = (beta[0] + beta_k) * ss.p_A[k] + tau * ss.E_TD[k]
314	
315	    # E[TY] = E[T * (beta[0] + sum beta[k]*1(A=k) + tau*T + eps_Y)]
316	    # = beta[0] * E[T] + sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * E[T * 1(A=k)] + tau * E[T^2] + 0
317	    ss.E_TY = beta[0] * 0.5 + sum(beta[k] * ss.E_TD[k] for k in range(1, K)) + tau * 0.5
318	
319	    return ss

322	# ====================================================================
323	# Topology 4: Collider -- 2D GAUSS-HERMITE
324	# ====================================================================
325	# DGP: T ~ N(0,1), eps_Y ~ N(0,1) independent
326	#       Y = tau * T + eps_Y
327	#       A | T, Y ~ Cat(softmax(g + dT * T + dY * Y))
328	#
329	# Reparametrize: let Z1=T, Z2=eps_Y, both N(0,1) independent
330	# Y = tau * Z1 + Z2
331	# A | Z1, Z2 ~ Cat(softmax(g + dT * Z1 + dY * (tau * Z1 + Z2)))
332	#            = Cat(softmax(g + (dT + tau * dY) * Z1 + dY * Z2))
333	
334	def compute_collider_ss(K, p):
335	    """Analytic sufficient stats for collider via 2D GH quadrature."""
336	    ss = AnalyticSuffStats(K, has_T=True)
337	    tau = p['tau']
338	    g = p['g']      # K-vector
339	    dT = p['dT']    # K-vector
340	    dY = p['dY']    # K-vector
341	
342	    # Quadrature over (Z1, Z2) = (T, eps_Y), both N(0,1)
343	    # Logits for each quadrature point: g + (dT + tau*dY) * Z1 + dY * Z2
344	    coeff1 = dT + tau * dY   # K-vector: coefficient of Z1
345	    coeff2 = dY               # K-vector: coefficient of Z2
346	
347	    # Compute softmax probabilities at each quadrature point
348	    # logits shape: (N_GH^2, K)
349	    logits = (g[None, :]
350	              + coeff1[None, :] * GH_X2_a_flat[:, None]
351	              + coeff2[None, :] * GH_X2_b_flat[:, None])
352	    probs = _softmax(logits)  # (N_GH^2, K)
353	
354	    # T = Z1, Y = tau * Z1 + Z2
355	    T_vals = GH_X2_a_flat
356	    Y_vals = tau * GH_X2_a_flat + GH_X2_b_flat
357	
358	    # Weighted expectations
359	    w = GH_W2_flat  # (N_GH^2,)
360	
361	    ss.p_A = (w[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
362	    ss.E_TD = (w[:, None] * T_vals[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
363	    ss.E_YD = (w[:, None] * Y_vals[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
364	
365	    # Moments of T and Y (independent of A, can compute analytically):
366	    ss.E_T = 0.0
367	    ss.E_T2 = 1.0
368	    ss.E_Y = 0.0  # E[tau*T + eps] = 0
369	    ss.E_TY = tau  # E[T(tau*T + eps)] = tau * E[T^2] = tau
370	
371	    return ss
372

374	# ====================================================================
375	# Topology 5: M-bias -- 2D GAUSS-HERMITE
376	# ====================================================================
377	# DGP: U1, U2 ~ N(0,1) independent
378	#       T = delta_coef * U1 + eta, eta ~ N(0,1)
379	#       Y = tau * T + lam * U2 + eps_Y, eps_Y ~ N(0,1)
380	#       A | U1, U2 ~ Cat(softmax(g + a1 * U1 + a2 * U2))
381	#
382	# Note: T and Y depend on (U1, U2, eta, eps_Y) but A only depends on (U1, U2).
383	# Since eta, eps_Y are independent of (U1, U2, A):
384	#   E[T * 1(A=k)] = delta_coef * E[U1 * 1(A=k)] + E[eta * 1(A=k)]
385	#                  = delta_coef * E[U1 * 1(A=k)]  (eta indep of A)
386	#
387	#   E[Y * 1(A=k)] = tau * E[T * 1(A=k)] + lam * E[U2 * 1(A=k)] + 0
388	#
389	# So we need 2D GH over (U1, U2) to compute:
390	#   P(A=k), E[U1 * 1(A=k)], E[U2 * 1(A=k)]
391	
392	def compute_mbias_ss(K, p):
393	    """Analytic sufficient stats for M-bias via 2D GH quadrature."""
394	    ss = AnalyticSuffStats(K, has_T=True)
395	    tau = p['tau']
396	    delta_coef = p['delta_coef']
397	    lam = p['lam']
398	    g = p['g']
399	    a1 = p['a1']
400	    a2 = p['a2']
401	
402	    # Logits: g + a1 * U1 + a2 * U2
403	    logits = (g[None, :]
404	              + a1[None, :] * GH_X2_a_flat[:, None]
405	              + a2[None, :] * GH_X2_b_flat[:, None])
406	    probs = _softmax(logits)  # (N_GH^2, K)
407	
408	    w = GH_W2_flat
409	    U1_vals = GH_X2_a_flat
410	    U2_vals = GH_X2_b_flat
411	
412	    ss.p_A = (w[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
413	    E_U1_Dk = (w[:, None] * U1_vals[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)  # E[U1 * 1(A=k)]
414	    E_U2_Dk = (w[:, None] * U2_vals[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)  # E[U2 * 1(A=k)]
415	
416	    # E[T * 1(A=k)] = delta_coef * E[U1 * 1(A=k)]
417	    ss.E_TD = delta_coef * E_U1_Dk
418	
419	    # E[Y * 1(A=k)] = tau * E[T * 1(A=k)] + lam * E[U2 * 1(A=k)]
420	    ss.E_YD = tau * ss.E_TD + lam * E_U2_Dk
421	
422	    # Marginal moments:
423	    # E[T] = 0 (since E[U1]=0, E[eta]=0)
424	    # E[T^2] = delta_coef^2 * E[U1^2] + E[eta^2] = delta_coef^2 + 1
425	    # E[Y] = 0
426	    # E[TY] = tau * E[T^2] + lam * E[T*U2]
427	    # E[T*U2] = E[(delta_coef * U1 + eta) * U2] = 0 (all independent)
428	    ss.E_T = 0.0
429	    ss.E_T2 = delta_coef**2 + 1.0
430	    ss.E_Y = 0.0
431	    ss.E_TY = tau * ss.E_T2
432	
433	    return ss

437	# Topology 6: Front-door -- 1D GAUSS-HERMITE
438	# ====================================================================
439	# DGP: U ~ N(0,1), T = alpha_U * U + eta (eta ~ N(0,1))
440	#       M | T ~ Cat(softmax(gamma + delta * T))  -- M is the "annotator" variable
441	#       Y = D_M @ beta[1:] + lam_U * U + eps_Y
442	# where D_M[j] = 1(M=j+1), j=0,...,K-2
443	#
444	# The regression is Y ~ 1 + T + D*_1 + ... + D*_{K-1}
445	# (M plays the role of A in the plim computation)
446	#
447	# T ~ N(0, sigma_T^2) where sigma_T^2 = alpha_U^2 + 1
448	# We do 1D GH over T (after rescaling for its variance).
449	#
450	# For the moments involving U:
451	# E[U | T] = Cov(U,T)/Var(T) * T = alpha_U / (alpha_U^2 + 1) * T
452	# (since Cov(U,T) = alpha_U, Var(T) = alpha_U^2 + 1)
453	#
454	# P(M=k) = E_T[softmax(gamma + delta * T)[k]]
455	# E[T * 1(M=k)] = E_T[T * softmax(gamma + delta * T)[k]]
456	# E[Y * 1(M=k)] = E[E[Y | T, M] * 1(M=k)]
457	#               = E_T[ E[Y|T,M=k] * softmax(gamma+delta*T)[k] ]
458	# E[Y|T,M=k] = beta[k] (if k>=1, else 0 for the intercept part from D_M)
459	#              + lam_U * E[U|T] + 0
460	# Wait, let me reconsider:
461	# Y = sum_{j=0}^{K-2} beta[j+1] * 1(M=j+1) + lam_U * U + eps_Y
462	# (from gen_frontdoor: Y = D @ beta[1:] + lam_U * U + eps_Y,
463	#  where beta = p['beta'] and D[j] = 1(M=j+1))
464	# There's no intercept beta[0] in the Y equation in gen_frontdoor!
465	# Let me re-check: gen_frontdoor has Y = D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['lam_U'] * U + eps_Y
466	# So Y = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * 1(M=k) + lam_U * U + eps_Y
467	#
468	# E[Y * 1(M=k)] = beta[k] * P(M=k) (for k>=1) + lam_U * E[U * 1(M=k)] + 0
469	# For k=0: E[Y * 1(M=0)] = 0 + lam_U * E[U * 1(M=0)] + 0
470	
471	def compute_frontdoor_ss(K, p):
472	    """Analytic sufficient stats for front-door via 1D GH quadrature."""
473	    ss = AnalyticSuffStats(K, has_T=True)
474	    alpha_U = p['alpha_U']
475	    lam_U = p['lam_U']
476	    gamma = p['gamma']
477	    delta_coef = p['delta']
478	    beta = p['beta']
479	
480	    sigma_T2 = alpha_U**2 + 1.0
481	    sigma_T = np.sqrt(sigma_T2)
482	
483	    # 1D GH over T ~ N(0, sigma_T^2): rescale nodes
484	    T_nodes = GH_X * sigma_T  # (N_GH,)
485	    T_weights = GH_W          # (N_GH,) -- already normalized for E_{N(0,1)}
486	
487	    # softmax(gamma + delta * T) at each T node
488	    # logits shape: (N_GH, K)
489	    logits = gamma[None, :] + delta_coef[None, :] * T_nodes[:, None]
490	    probs = _softmax(logits)  # (N_GH, K)
491	
492	    # P(M=k) = E_T[softmax(gamma + delta * T)[k]]
493	    ss.p_A = (T_weights[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
494	
495	    # E[T * 1(M=k)] = E_T[T * softmax(gamma + delta * T)[k]]
496	    ss.E_TD = (T_weights[:, None] * T_nodes[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
497	
498	    # E[U * 1(M=k)] via the law of iterated expectations:
499	    # E[U * 1(M=k)] = E_T[ E[U|T] * P(M=k|T) ]
500	    # E[U|T] = alpha_U / sigma_T^2 * T
501	    E_U_given_T = alpha_U / sigma_T2 * T_nodes  # (N_GH,)
502	    E_U_Mk = (T_weights[:, None] * E_U_given_T[:, None] * probs).sum(axis=0)
503	
504	    # E[Y * 1(M=k)] = beta[k] * P(M=k) (for k>=1) + lam_U * E[U * 1(M=k)]
505	    ss.E_YD = np.zeros(K)
506	    for k in range(K):
507	        beta_k = beta[k] if k >= 1 else 0.0
508	        ss.E_YD[k] = beta_k * ss.p_A[k] + lam_U * E_U_Mk[k]
509	
510	    # Marginal moments:
511	    # E[T] = 0
512	    # E[T^2] = sigma_T^2
513	    # E[Y] = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(M=k) + lam_U * E[U] + 0
514	    #       = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(M=k)
515	    ss.E_T = 0.0
516	    ss.E_T2 = sigma_T2
517	    ss.E_Y = sum(beta[k] * ss.p_A[k] for k in range(1, K))
518	
519	    # E[TY] = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * E[T * 1(M=k)] + lam_U * E[T*U] + E[T*eps_Y]
520	    # E[T*U] = Cov(T,U) = alpha_U (since both mean 0)
521	    # E[T*eps_Y] = 0
522	    ss.E_TY = sum(beta[k] * ss.E_TD[k] for k in range(1, K)) + lam_U * alpha_U
523	
524	    return ss
525

528	# Topology 7: IV -- 1D GAUSS-HERMITE over U, binary Z
529	# ====================================================================
530	# DGP: Z ~ Bern(0.5), U ~ N(0,1), eps_Y ~ N(0,1)
531	#       A | Z, U ~ Cat(softmax(g + dZ * Z + dU * U))
532	#       Y = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * 1(A=k) + lam * U + eps_Y
533	#
534	# Wald estimator: tau_hat = RF / FS*[1]
535	# RF = E[Y|Z=1] - E[Y|Z=0]
536	# FS[k] = P(A=k|Z=1) - P(A=k|Z=0)
537	#
538	# P(A=k|Z=z) = E_U[softmax(g + dZ * z + dU * U)[k]]
539	# E[Y|Z=z] = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(A=k|Z=z) + lam * E[U] + E[eps]
540	#           = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(A=k|Z=z)
541	
542	def compute_iv_ss(K, p):
543	    """Analytic sufficient stats for IV via 1D GH quadrature."""
544	    ivss = AnalyticIVSuffStats(K)
545	    g = p['g']
546	    dZ = p['dZ']
547	    dU = p['dU']
548	    beta = p['beta']
549	    lam = p['lam']
550	
551	    # P(A=k|Z=z) for z=0 and z=1
552	    # logits for Z=0: g + dU * U
553	    logits_z0 = g[None, :] + dU[None, :] * GH_X[:, None]  # (N_GH, K)
554	    probs_z0 = _softmax(logits_z0)
555	    P_A_z0 = (GH_W[:, None] * probs_z0).sum(axis=0)  # K-vector
556	
557	    logits_z1 = g[None, :] + dZ[None, :] + dU[None, :] * GH_X[:, None]
558	    probs_z1 = _softmax(logits_z1)
559	    P_A_z1 = (GH_W[:, None] * probs_z1).sum(axis=0)  # K-vector
560	
561	    # First stage
562	    ivss.FS = P_A_z1 - P_A_z0  # K-vector
563	
564	    # Reduced form
565	    # E[Y|Z=z] = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(A=k|Z=z)
566	    # (lam * E[U] = 0, E[eps] = 0, beta[0] cancels out since it's not in gen_iv)
567	    # Actually gen_iv: Y = D @ p['beta'][1:] + p['lam'] * U + eps
568	    # So Y = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * 1(A=k) + lam * U + eps
569	    # E[Y|Z=z] = sum_{k=1}^{K-1} beta[k] * P(A=k|Z=z)
570	    E_Y_z0 = sum(beta[k] * P_A_z0[k] for k in range(1, K))
571	    E_Y_z1 = sum(beta[k] * P_A_z1[k] for k in range(1, K))
572	
573	    ivss.RF = E_Y_z1 - E_Y_z0
574	
575	    return ivss
576

579	# Plim computation (from original, unchanged)
580	# ====================================================================
581	def plim_ols_with_T(C, ss):
582	    """Plim of OLS regression Y ~ 1 + T + D*_1 + ... + D*_{K-1}."""
583	    K = ss.K
584	    q = C @ ss.p_A        # misclassified P(A*=k)
585	    ct = C @ ss.E_TD       # E[T * 1(A*=k)]
586	    cy = C @ ss.E_YD       # E[Y * 1(A*=k)]
587	    dim = K + 1
588	    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
589	    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
590	    EZZ[0, 1] = ss.E_T
591	    EZZ[1, 0] = ss.E_T
592	    EZZ[1, 1] = ss.E_T2
593	    EZZ[0, 2:] = q[1:]
594	    EZZ[2:, 0] = q[1:]
595	    EZZ[1, 2:] = ct[1:]
596	    EZZ[2:, 1] = ct[1:]
597	    for j in range(K - 1):
598	        EZZ[j + 2, j + 2] = q[j + 1]
599	    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
600	    EZY[0] = ss.E_Y
601	    EZY[1] = ss.E_TY
602	    EZY[2:] = cy[1:]
603	    try:
604	        return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)
605	    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
606	        return np.full(dim, np.nan)
607	
608	
609	def plim_ols_exposure(C, ss):
610	    """Plim of OLS regression Y ~ 1 + D*_1 + ... + D*_{K-1}."""
611	    K = ss.K
612	    q = C @ ss.p_A
613	    cy = C @ ss.E_YD
614	    dim = K
615	    EZZ = np.zeros((dim, dim))
616	    EZZ[0, 0] = 1.0
617	    EZZ[0, 1:] = q[1:]
618	    EZZ[1:, 0] = q[1:]
619	    for j in range(K - 1):
620	        EZZ[j + 1, j + 1] = q[j + 1]
621	    EZY = np.zeros(dim)
622	    EZY[0] = ss.E_Y
623	    EZY[1:] = cy[1:]
624	    try:
625	        return np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY)
626	    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
627	        return np.full(dim, np.nan)
628	
629	
630	def plim_iv_single(C, ss):
631	    """Plim of Wald IV estimator with misclassified A."""
632	    FS_star = C @ ss.FS
633	    if abs(FS_star[1]) < 1e-15:
634	        return np.nan
635	    return ss.RF / FS_star[1]
636

638	def get_tau_at_C(topo, C, ss):
639	    if topo == 'iv':
640	        return plim_iv_single(C, ss)
641	    elif topo == 'exposure':
642	        return plim_ols_exposure(C, ss)[1]
643	    else:
644	        return plim_ols_with_T(C, ss)[1]

647	def get_tau_true(topo, K, params, ss):
648	    """True causal parameter.
649	
650	    For correctly-identified topologies: tau_true = plim(I).
651	    For protective topologies (collider, mbias): tau_true = DGP tau,
652	    so B(0) = plim(I) - tau != 0 (existing bias from Berkson/M-bias).
653	    """
654	    p = params[topo]
655	    if topo == 'collider':
656	        return p['tau']
657	    elif topo == 'mbias':
658	        return p['tau']
659	    else:
660	        return get_tau_at_C(topo, np.eye(K), ss)

664	# Batched bias curve computation (from original, unchanged)
665	# ====================================================================
666	def compute_bias_curve(topo, C0, ss, tau_true, delta_step=DELTA_STEP):
667	    K = C0.shape[0]
668	    min_diag = np.diag(C0).min()
669	    if min_diag >= 1.0:
670	        delta_max = 10.0
671	    else:
672	        delta_max = min(1.0 / (1.0 - min_diag), 10.0)
673	
674	    deltas = np.arange(0, delta_max + delta_step / 2, delta_step)
675	    n = len(deltas)
676	    d = deltas[:, None]
677	
678	    if topo == 'iv':
679	        FS0 = C0 @ ss.FS
680	        fs_star = (1 - d) * ss.FS[None, :] + d * FS0[None, :]
681	        denom = fs_star[:, 1]
682	        taus = np.where(np.abs(denom) < 1e-15, np.nan, ss.RF / denom)
683	    elif topo == 'exposure':
684	        pA0 = C0 @ ss.p_A
685	        YD0 = C0 @ ss.E_YD
686	        q = (1 - d) * ss.p_A[None, :] + d * pA0[None, :]
687	        cy = (1 - d) * ss.E_YD[None, :] + d * YD0[None, :]
688	        dim = K
689	        EZZ = np.zeros((n, dim, dim))
690	        EZZ[:, 0, 0] = 1.0
691	        EZZ[:, 0, 1:] = q[:, 1:]
692	        EZZ[:, 1:, 0] = q[:, 1:]
693	        for j in range(K - 1):
694	            EZZ[:, j + 1, j + 1] = q[:, j + 1]
695	        EZY = np.zeros((n, dim))
696	        EZY[:, 0] = ss.E_Y
697	        EZY[:, 1:] = cy[:, 1:]
698	        try:
699	            coefs = np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY[..., np.newaxis])[..., 0]
700	            taus = coefs[:, 1]
701	        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
702	            taus = np.full(n, np.nan)
703	    else:
704	        pA0 = C0 @ ss.p_A
705	        TD0 = C0 @ ss.E_TD
706	        YD0 = C0 @ ss.E_YD
707	        q = (1 - d) * ss.p_A[None, :] + d * pA0[None, :]
708	        ct = (1 - d) * ss.E_TD[None, :] + d * TD0[None, :]
709	        cy = (1 - d) * ss.E_YD[None, :] + d * YD0[None, :]
710	        dim = K + 1
711	        EZZ = np.zeros((n, dim, dim))
712	        EZZ[:, 0, 0] = 1.0
713	        EZZ[:, 0, 1] = ss.E_T
714	        EZZ[:, 1, 0] = ss.E_T
715	        EZZ[:, 1, 1] = ss.E_T2
716	        EZZ[:, 0, 2:] = q[:, 1:]
717	        EZZ[:, 2:, 0] = q[:, 1:]
718	        EZZ[:, 1, 2:] = ct[:, 1:]
719	        EZZ[:, 2:, 1] = ct[:, 1:]
720	        for j in range(K - 1):
721	            EZZ[:, j + 2, j + 2] = q[:, j + 1]
722	        EZY = np.zeros((n, dim))
723	        EZY[:, 0] = ss.E_Y
724	        EZY[:, 1] = ss.E_TY
725	        EZY[:, 2:] = cy[:, 1:]
726	        try:
727	            coefs = np.linalg.solve(EZZ, EZY[..., np.newaxis])[..., 0]
728	            taus = coefs[:, 1]
729	        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
730	            taus = np.full(n, np.nan)
731	
732	    bias_abs = np.abs(taus - tau_true)
733	    return deltas, bias_abs
734

736	def check_monotonicity(bias_abs, topo, tol=MONO_TOL):
737	    valid = ~np.isnan(bias_abs)
738	    ba = bias_abs[valid]
739	    if len(ba) < 2:
740	        return 0
741	    diffs = np.diff(ba)
742	    if topo in NON_DECREASING:
743	        return int(np.sum(diffs < -tol))
744	    else:
745	        return int(np.sum(diffs > tol))
